role: Persisted, once-computed derivatives of a workout's sample stream (α1 bands, HR-zone seconds, split extremes, moving time, energy/economy, narratives) stored on WorkoutMetadata.analysisSnapshot and rebuilt per-view when stale.
types: WorkoutAnalysisSnapshot: struct (Codable, Equatable) — cached analysis fields + schema/narrative-language staleness check
toplevel: Codable is synthesized from the stored lets (all optional except schemaVersion), so an older snapshot missing a new optional field decodes it as nil; a snapshot missing schemaVersion fails to decode and WorkoutMetadata.init(from:) propagates the throw. narrativeLanguage default parameter evaluates LanguageManager.appLocale.identifier at each call.

flags.text: Header says the CSV/PDF exporters read the cached snapshot and the narrative comment says the in-app card and 'the PDF's executive-summary page agree verbatim'; no exporter or PDF code reads analysisSnapshot or howYouDidNarrative (grep: only the builder, FitnessPostSummaryView+Feeling, AppFactResolver, WorkoutRecorder+Lifecycle, WorkoutRecoveryService, WorkoutMetadata).

units.does: True when the stored schemaVersion < currentVersion (2) or narrativeLanguage differs from the app's current locale identifier (nil counts as different). FitnessPostSummaryView+Feeling.swift:96 rebuilds and writes back the snapshot when true.
Returns the first non-empty of howYouDidNarrative, heroNarrative, else nil.

flags.text: displayNarrative has no reader in the repo (grep finds only its declaration, tests included); FitnessPostSummaryView+Feeling.generateSessionAnalysis reads howYouDidNarrative directly and falls back to legacyGenerateSessionAnalysis, not to heroNarrative.

units.does: Memberwise initializer with every field defaulted to nil (schemaVersion to currentVersion, narrativeLanguage to the current app locale identifier); empty narrative strings are normalized to nil.

branches.effect: stored as nil; otherwise stored as given (nil stays nil)
